text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the final URA showdown, Trainer<n>Kiryuin
admits that she has looked up<n>to me as her ideal
and as her rival.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though her frustration is evident,<n>Happy Meek
takes her loss in stride<n>in an effort to further
improve herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They both press on, promising to<n>strive for an even
brighter tomorrow.
